notes.title: Demo Patch v1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Horse Farm Simulator Demo.

This is the demo patch v1.1 that includes:


 The issue where horses would get stuck in the riding area has been resolved.
 The bug where customers got stuck at the farm entrance has been fixed.
 The limits on two tasks have been reduced: the task to host 50 customers and the task to sell 20 toasts. Now, you only need to host 35 customers and sell 15 toasts.
 The outline for cooked toast was missing, and this has been fixed.
 Some translation errors have been corrected. If you notice any missing or incorrect translations, please let us know and we'll fix them. We appreciate your help.
 A bug related to sending horses to the stable has been fixed. When you interact with a horse and tell it to go to the stable, it will now go to an empty stable and, if there is food and water, it will consume them.
 If your horses are hungry or thirsty, you should send them to the stable and fill the stable with food and water, or you can give them hay or carrots directly.
 Now, when you go to sleep, your farm will automatically close, and any waiting customers will leave.
 Sound effects have been added when working with the pitchfork.
 A new patch update will be coming soon, and we are continuing to address the remaining issues.



If you share any issues you encounter with us on Discord or our Steam community, we will do our best to resolve them as quickly as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051301/86a4e3f6e278083196166fa5a4402069ccdf4b68.png

Continue to follow us and stay updated on the developments!

See you soon! 
Glow Egg Games

notes.title: Demo Update v1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Horse Farm Simulator Demo.

This is the demo update v1.0 that includes:



 The environment has been changed, new structures have been added.
 You now start the game with two horses.
 Guide signs have been added.
 A training feature has been added, allowing you to practice.
 Cargo boxes can be thrown in the trash.
 A mechanic for collecting hay with a pitchfork has been added.
 A car has been added to the game; you can load hay onto the car and bring it to the farm.
 You can sit on benches to calmly enjoy the surroundings.
 The delivery fee has been reduced.
 The game’s background music has been removed and replaced with ambient sounds.
 A small gate has been added for entry into the farm.
 The size of the horse has been slightly increased.
 You can hit the customers with a bat.
 New customer models have been added.
 A temporary fix has been applied for the map falling bug :)
 The speed of the day has been slightly reduced.
 You can set a price by clicking on the sign at the horse riding area.
 Missing translations have been completed.
 A new product has been added to the café: orange juice. You can make and sell orange juice using a blender with oranges.
 2 new achievements have been added.
 You can now directly give products to the horse with the cargo boxes. It’s not necessary to put them in the storage first, but you can if you want.
 The horse no longer gets sick immediately.
 We have addressed and fixed the issues reported on Discord and the Steam discussions section as much as possible.


Note: If you encounter any issues with launching the demo, please uninstall the game from your computer and reinstall it. If the problem persists, let us know.


If you share any issues you encounter with us on Discord or our Steam community, we will do our best to resolve them as quickly as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051301/86a4e3f6e278083196166fa5a4402069ccdf4b68.png

Continue to follow us and stay updated on the developments!

See you soon! 
Glow Egg Games

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.2.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Horse Farm Simulator Demo.

This is the demo patch v0.2.4 that includes:


 The bug where you get stuck after exiting the computer has been fixed.
 The bug where achievements wouldn't unlock has been fixed.
 Some missing translations have been completed, and we will finish the remaining ones as soon as possible.
 Customers now leave plastic water bottle trash around after ordering water.
 A limit has been added to the pricing on the café pricing screen.
 Horses now leave droppings when they are sick, and you can throw the droppings using a shovel.
 The bug where boxes purchased from the market would end up on top of the cabin has been fixed; they now land on the ground at the entrance.
 The bug where customers would get stuck at the entrance gate when entering the farm has been fixed.
 The bug where players couldn't sleep after midnight has been fixed; you can now sleep between 7:00 PM and 7:00 AM.



If you share any issues you encounter with us on Discord or our Steam community, we will do our best to resolve them as quickly as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051301/86a4e3f6e278083196166fa5a4402069ccdf4b68.png

Continue to follow us and stay updated on the developments!

See you soon!

notes.title: Horse Farm Simulator Demo Version Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce that our game’s demo version is now live! 🌟 In this special version, you’ll have the chance to take your first steps into the world of horse farm management.

In this demo, you will be able to experience some basic mechanics. But don't worry, there will be much more content and new adventures waiting for you in the early access version!🐴

Make sure to check the demo to learn what will be included in the early access! If you notice any issues or gaps in the demo version, please don’t hesitate to let us know. If you have any suggestions on what you’d like to see, you can reach out to us via Discord or the discussions section!

We are working hard to provide you with the best game possible, so your constructive feedback is very important to us!

Have fun! 🎮🎊

See you soon!
Glow Egg Games
